#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

// Utility class for assertions
class Util {
public:
    static void ASSERT(bool assertion) {
        if (!assertion) throw std::runtime_error("Assertion failed");
    }
    Util() = delete;
};

// Stack class for integers
class IntStack {
public:
    vector<int> array;
    size_t size = 0;

    IntStack() {
        array.reserve(8);
    }

    explicit IntStack(size_t capacity) {
        array.reserve(capacity);
    }

    void push(int item) {
        if (size >= array.capacity())
            resize();
        if (size < array.size()) {
            array[size] = item;
        } else {
            array.push_back(item);
        }
        ++size;
    }

    size_t getSize() const {
        return size;
    }

    int get(size_t i) const {
        ASSERT(i < size);
        return array[i];
    }

private:
    void resize() {
        size_t new_capacity = max<size_t>(array.capacity() * 2, 1);
        array.reserve(new_capacity);
        // No need to copy manually as vector already manages resizing
    }
};

// Class encapsulating modular arithmetic
class Modulo {
public:
    virtual long long modulus() const = 0;
    virtual ~Modulo() = default;

    IntStack factorial;
    IntStack invFactorial;

    Modulo() {
        factorial.push(1);
        invFactorial.push(1);
    }

    long long fact(int n) {
        while (factorial.getSize() <= (size_t) n) {
            factorial.push((int) mult(factorial.get(factorial.getSize() - 1), (int) factorial.getSize()));
        }
        return factorial.get(n);
    }

    long long fInv(int n) {
        int lastKnown = invFactorial.getSize() - 1;
        if (lastKnown < n) {
            vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
            fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
            for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); ++i) {
                fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
            }
            for (int i = (int)fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                invFactorial.push((int)fInv[i]);
            }
        }
        return invFactorial.get(n);
    }

    long long paritySign(long long k) const {
        return (k & 1) ? modulus() - 1 : 1;
    }

    long long ncr(int n, int r) {
        ASSERT(n >= 0);
        if (r < 0 || n < r)
            return 0;
        return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
    }

    long long smallInv(int n) {
        return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
    }

    long long normalize(long long x) const {
        x %= modulus();
        if (x < 0) x += modulus();
        return x;
    }

    long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
        long long v = a + b;
        return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
    }

    long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
        return (a * b) % modulus();
    }

    long long mult(const vector<long long>& args) const {
        long long r = 1;
        for (auto i : args)
            r = mult(r, i);
        return r;
    }

    long long div(long long a, long long b) {
        return mult(a, inv(b));
    }

    long long inv(long long value) {
        long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
        for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
            long long q = g / r;
            g %= r;

            long long temp = g;
            g = r;
            r = temp;

            x -= q * y;

            temp = x;
            x = y;
            y = temp;
        }

        ASSERT(g == 1);
        ASSERT(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());

        return normalize(x);
    }
};

// Implementation for modulus 998244353
class Mod998 : public Modulo {
public:
    long long modulus() const override {
        return 998244353LL;
    }
};

// Main processing class
class HZSShufflesCards {
private:
    const Modulo* mod;
    int n, m;

public:
    void solve() {
        cin >> n >> m;
        static Mod998 modObj;
        mod = &modObj;

        // Precompute inverse factorials
        mod->fInv(n + m);

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;

        for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = mod->mult(p, n - i, mod->inv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = mod->add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;

        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long sign = mod->paritySign(k + 1);
            long long numPhases = mod->div(m + k, k);
            long long term = mod->mult(sign, mod->ncr(n, k), numPhases, phaseSize);
            answer = mod->add(answer, term);
        }

        cout << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
